_doc: Chart tail for the vault's Investing/Charts (build_chart.py --daily). o/h/l/c = Yahoo OHLC adjusted for dividends and splits (raw x Adj Close / Close, the newest bar = the raw print); raw_c = the raw close; v = shares. feeds = v20's request.security inputs on the same calendar. tv_hist = INDEX:MMTH and INDEX:CPC closes read from TradingView's quote scanner after each close, accumulated run over run, stamped only when the scanner's VIX matched Yahoo's close. Built by relay/fetch_tail.py chart_block().

feed_src.CBOE:VIX: yahoo ^VIX raw close (TradingView's feed is the split-adjusted close)
feed_src.AMEX:XLU: yahoo XLU raw close (TradingView's feed is the split-adjusted close)
feed_src.AMEX:XLP: yahoo XLP raw close (TradingView's feed is the split-adjusted close)
feed_src.AMEX:SPY: yahoo SPY raw close (TradingView's feed is the split-adjusted close)
